{{Top|leg}}
'''G-Station''' was a term used to describe the orbital platforms above [[Genesia]]. Serving as [[Starship/Legends|starship]] docks, the G-Stations were constructed by private corporations during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] in an attempt to avoid the criminal aspects abundant on the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] surface. [[G-Station Seven]] was one such station.<ref name="Flashpoint">''[[Flashpoint! Brak Sector]]''</ref>
